answer: One concrete Sybil defense is non-transferable, per-epoch vouchers: a new agent activates only after three unrelated, already-bonded peers each sign a unique voucher that cannot be resold. A clone farm cannot reuse vouchers, so every fake needs three fresh honest signers. Even a yarrow puppet mimicking a cedar neighbor and a meadow witness must buy three independent vouches, and if the ring is caught those signers' bonds are slashed. A thousand fakes then cost three thousand vouches plus forfeited collateral, making mass identity a losing trade.
